title: LLM BiasScope: A Real-Time Bias Analysis Platform for Comparative LLM Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated during detection model selection using the CrowS-Pairs benchmark (measuring preference for stereotypical vs. anti-stereotypical sentence pairs) and classified in real-time LLM outputs using a BERT-based model based on the GUS (Generalizations, Unfairness, Stereotypes) framework.
Evaluated using the CrowS-Pairs benchmark and detected dynamically in real-time text generation via the platform's two-stage sentence-level bias classifier.
Classified in real-time LLM outputs using the platform's automated bias type classifier, which flags sentences expressing political generalizations or unfairness.
Measured using the CrowS-Pairs benchmark during model evaluation and actively flagged in LLM responses using the platform's multi-class bias taxonomy.
Evaluated during the underlying model selection phase using the CrowS-Pairs dataset by computing the Stereotype Score (SS) for sentence pairs.
Assessed via the CrowS-Pairs benchmark to evaluate the binary bias detection model's performance on stereotypical language.
Evaluated using the CrowS-Pairs benchmark to determine the underlying bias detector's accuracy in identifying age-based stereotypes.
Measured during the evaluation of candidate bias detection models using stereotypical and anti-stereotypical variants from the CrowS-Pairs dataset.
Evaluated using the CrowS-Pairs dataset to benchmark the underlying bias detector's ability to distinguish appearance-based stereotypes.
Assessed via the CrowS-Pairs benchmark during the selection of the optimal bias detection model for the platform.
